title: Sealed arm key for a blind-rating A/B run
description: Written before any run starts and not read back until every slot is rated. Labels (A, B, ...) map to a commit plus a name; the prediction is sealed with the arms.

coin.description: how the label assignment was decided, with the rule fixed before the flip

baseline_parent.description: the treatment arm's parent commit, when the arms are a commit and its parent

prediction.description: which arm should win on which metric, and by what mechanism, written in a sentence before the first run. A run with no sealed prediction is a measurement, not a test.

redactions.description: vocabulary the treatment introduces, redacted inline as [redacted] by extract-rated.py; written at sealing time, not after

rubric.description: anchors for the 1-5 actionability rating, at least for 2 and 3, written before rating
